programme.desc: Something as simple as a family picnic has an elegance in France. programme.desc: Laotian cuisine is packed with bold, balanced flavours. Diana is also joined in the kitchen by Jerry Mai (chef) who prepares ‘Salt Crust Grilled Fish,’ a whole snapper filled with aromatics that celebrates Laos’s fresh and vibrant flavours.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Diana focuses on the foods of Southern India. Jacob Leung (chef and author) prepares ‘Red Onion Bhaji with Yoghurt Dipping Sauce,’ his favourite street food snack.
